description: Create a batch payout via POST /v1/payments/payouts. sender_batch_header carries metadata; items is an array of payout_item objects each with recipient_type, amount { currency, value }, receiver, and note. Async — poll get_payout to track status.

body.description: Additional payout body fields merged into the request.

items.description: Array of payout items. Each: { recipient_type, amount: { value, currency }, receiver, note, sender_item_id }.

sender_batch_header.description: Batch metadata: { sender_batch_id, email_subject, email_message, recipient_type }.

name: create_batch_payout
